_about: Hand-labelled retrieval set. Each item names a document, a question, and one
or more spans that MUST appear in a retrieved chunk for the retrieval to count
as correct. Comparison is case-insensitive on NFKC-normalised, whitespace-
collapsed text, so PDF ligatures and line wrapping do not cause false misses.
`kind` groups questions by the retrieval behaviour they probe, because the
aggregate number hides the interesting part — dense retrieval is strong on
`semantic` and weak on `exact`, and that gap is exactly what Phase 2 targets.
`expect` is ANY-match: one span found is a hit. Run `python -m backend.eval
--check` after editing; it fails if a span does not occur in the source text.
